headline: Enzo Maresca calls for 'balance' after Man City suffer third straight Premier League defeat
description: Enzo Maresca has said he is "concerned" about Manchester City's form after they suffered a third Premier League defeat with a 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday.

headline: Hislop questions 'predictable' Man City after another defeat
description: Hislop questions 'predictable' Man City after another defeat

headline: Man United hit 40-year low after dropping into Premier League relegation zone
description: Manchester United have ended a day in the Premier League relegation zone for the first time in 40 years at this stage of a season.

headline: Man City slip to third straight defeat as Liam Delap inspires Nottingham Forest
description: Liam Delap's emphatic brace earned Nottingham Forest a first home win of the season and piled the misery on Manchester City with a 3-1 victory.

headline: Nottingham Forest condemn Man City to 3rd straight Premier League loss
description: Nottingham Forest condemned Manchester City to a third straight Premier League loss as Enzo Maresca's previously unbeaten side slipped further behind leaders Arsenal.

headline: Premier League recap: Man City's fall at Forest sees Arsenal pull away in title race
description: Another weekend of European soccer is underway, with Man City falling further behind the Premier League champions after Arsenal beat Hull City.
